730:t_1:4.en:
$$かなめ$$
「...Then that $$アサキム$$ guy... $$セツコ$$'s teammates...」

730:t_1:5.en:
$$シン$$
「Yeah, that's right. $$アサキム$$ killed Captain $$デンゼル$$ and Lieutenant $$トビー$$ of $$グローリー・スター$$...」

730:t_1:6.en:
$$シン$$
「He plunged $$セツコ$$ into despair to awaken her $$スフィア$$.」

730:t_1:7.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「The Captain $$デンゼル$$ and Lieutenant $$トビー$$ with us now are their counterparts from a parallel world.」

730:t_1:8.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「$$アサキム$$ originally brought even them here just to upset $$セツコ$$.」

730:t_1:9.en:
$$かなめ$$
「The more I hear, the more of that bastard's cruelty comes out.」

730:t_1:10.en:
$$宗介$$
「But what I heard from $$ランド$$ gives a somewhat different impression.」

730:t_1:11.en:
$$ガロード$$
「$$ランド$$ doesn't hate $$アサキム$$. His biggest reason for fighting him is that $$アサキム$$ is after his $$スフィア$$.」

730:t_1:12.en:
$$ティファ$$
「I think $$ランド$$ is grateful to $$アサキム$$ for saving $$メール$$ after she got separated from him during the $$大時空震動$$.」

730:t_1:13.en:
$$ロラン$$
「He usually hides those feelings out of consideration for $$セツコ$$, though.」

730:t_1:14.en:
$$アマタ$$
「The more I hear, the less I understand $$アサキム$$.」

730:t_1:15.en:
$$ゼシカ$$
「So he'll be good or evil, as long as it serves his goal.」

730:t_1:17.en:
$$アマタ$$
「Weren't you listening, $$カグラ$$? He's collecting $$スフィア$$s.」

730:t_1:18.en:
$$シン$$
「That's why he put $$セツコ$$ through hell and is after the lives of $$ランド$$, $$クロウ$$... and $n.」

730:t_1:19.en:
$$カグラ$$
「Even I know that. I want to know what he's trying to do once he gets those $$スフィア$$s.」

730:t_1:21.en:
$$ロラン$$
「I suppose it really is to defeat the $$御使い$$s...」

730:t_1:22.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Probably. He seems pretty angry about the curse they put on him.」

730:t_1:24.en:
$$ゼシカ$$
「In fairy tales, everyone wants eternal youth and immortality. But reality seems different.」

730:t_1:25.en:
$$ガロード$$
「...I understand how he feels, a little...」

730:t_1:27.en:
$$ガロード$$
「If I became immortal and $$ティファ$$ grew old and died before me, I'm sure I couldn't bear it...」

730:t_1:30.en:
$$フォウ$$
「Going on living alone after everyone you care about is gone... I think that loneliness must be unbearably painful.」

730:t_1:31.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「But he cannot even end his own life... That is like eternal torture.」

730:t_1:32.en:
$$ロラン$$
「$$ディアナ$$ said it too. An eternity lived entirely alone has no meaning...」

730:t_1:33.en:
$$ミコノ$$
「He's collecting $$スフィア$$s to gain the power to take revenge on the $$御使い$$s...」

730:t_1:34.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「So he intends to break their immortality with that power...」

730:t_1:35.en:
$$宗介$$
「But that means giving up the lives of $n and the others. I cannot accept that.」

730:t_1:36.en:
$$シン$$
「And I don't intend to forgive him for what he's done...!」

730:t_1:37.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Neither do I. Whatever your reasons, there are things you just can't do.」

730:t_1:38.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「But if he were to cooperate with us to defeat the $$御使い$$s...」

730:t_1:39.en:
$$カグラ$$
「I wouldn't get my hopes up about that.」

730:t_1:40.en:
$$アマタ$$
「I guess we really have no choice but to fight.」

730:t_1:41.en:
$$宗介$$
「If we can stop him from moving, the system to seal him away is ready.」

730:t_1:42.en:
$$ロラン$$
「If we do end up fighting him, hesitation will get us killed...」

730:t_1:43.en:
$$アマタ$$
「I know. If he'll turn to evil for his goal, we have our own reasons we can't lose.」

730:t_1:44.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「...It is almost time to descend into the atmosphere.」

730:t_1:45.en:
$$シン$$
「Our battle with $$アサキム$$ has continued since the $$多元戦争$$... So it will finally end soon...」

730:t_1:47.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Have you sorted out your feelings, $$セツコ$$?」

730:t_1:49.en:
$$セツコ$$
「If we leave him unchecked, more sorrow will spread.」

730:t_1:50.en:
$$セツコ$$
「I... will fight $$アサキム・ドーウィン$$, for myself and for the world.」

730:t_1:51.en:
$$スズネ$$
「How do you feel, $$ランド$$?」

730:t_1:52.en:
$$ランド$$
「Well... you know... I tried thinking it over with what little brain I've got...」

730:t_1:53.en:
$$ランド$$
「In the end, I still don't get it!」

730:t_1:55.en:
$$ランド$$
「So that's where I stand. I'll decide the rest once I see him.」

730:t_1:56.en:
$$クロウ$$
「OK. If that's your answer, it's fine by me.」

730:t_1:57.en:
$n
「We'll back you up too, so let's give it everything we've got, $$セツコ$$, $$ランド$$.」

730:t_1:59.en:
$$ランド$$
「You say that, but watch yourself too. He's after every $$リアクター$$.」

730:t_1:60.en:
$$宗介$$
「There is no need to worry. We will look after $n.」

730:t_1:61.en:
$$デュオ$$
「Then the Short Straw Alliance will back up $$クロウ$$.」

730:t_1:62.en:
$$シン$$
「$$カミーユ$$ and the rest of us will protect $$セツコ$$.」

730:t_1:63.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「Then we shall take responsibility for keeping an eye on $$ランド$$.」

730:t_1:65.en:
$$アムロ$$
「This does not concern only the $$リアクター$$s, after all.」

730:t_1:66.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Let's all unite and fight him together.」

730:t_1:69.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Will sugar water do as a thank-you?」

730:t_1:74.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Don't forget how many people will be sad if that bastard kills you.」

730:t_1:76.en:
$$トビー$$
「$$グローリー・スター$$ just wouldn't feel right without its ace.」

730:t_1:80.en:
$$エスター$$
「Let's win for sure, $$クロウ$$!」

730:t_1:81.en:
$$マルグリット$$
「I entrust His Highness's unfulfilled wish to you.」
